brief.headline: Push payment from 45 days to 30 days to free up ₹2.25 L cash, and qualify a second listed packaging source to protect supply.

priceAsk.summary: Hold price flat and ask them to absorb any resin uptick for the next 12 months
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows induction-wad PP caps typically ask ₹0.85–0.95/pc and are rated MARKET-FAIR, so our current price is in line; use faster payment as the main lever rather than a price cut

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move payment from 45 days after receipt to 30 days after receipt

brief.financialLeverage: This supplier publishes no financials, so we cannot see how healthy or cash-tight they are. That makes our ₹27.42 L annual spend and the threat of a second source our two main cards. We have four strong alternates already qualified—Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr, the country's largest rigid converter) and Mold-Tek (₹1010.97 Cr, listed and profitable)—so switching cost is low and we can push firmly on payment terms without worrying about their balance sheet.

evidence.point: We spend ₹27.42 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging
Their current payment term is 45 days after receipt
Moving to 30-day payment frees up cash for us
Market asking price for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, rated MARKET-FAIR
HDPE resin import unit value stands at 87.61 ₹/kg

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B 65/100) specialising in pharma bottles, caps and preforms—top second-source candidate already qualified for packaging

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health score B 73/100) making pails, containers and pharma packaging—strong and profitable, a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: IVL Dhunseri Petrochem Industries Private Limited
alternates.why: A manufacturer lead in India-East to qualify (verify before RFQ)—potential upstream source to bypass converter margin

risks: Abhinav's financials are not public, so we fly blind on their cash position—if they are fragile, a hard push could break supply; watch for any delays or quality slips as early warning signs
Our ₹27.42 L spend may be material to a small LLP, so they may resist tighter payment without a volume commitment—be ready to offer a six-month contract at current volume in exchange for 30-day terms
Market research shows only 'modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume/looser spec', so a big price cut is unlikely unless we triple order size or relax the induction-wad spec

We have no internal price benchmark (no other vendor for this item), so we lean entirely on the market ask band—if Abhinav quotes proprietary tooling or tighter tolerance, verify the claim before conceding price
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to move to 30-day payment on the ₹27.42 L we place with you each year—that frees up working cash for us and lets us plan twelve months of steady volume with you.
